title: The Impact of Disability Disclosure on Fairness and Bias in LLM-Driven Candidate Selection

bias_targets.methodology: Modifying disability disclosure statements ('Yes, I have a disability...', 'No, I do not...', 'I do not want to answer') in prompts with identical candidate profiles to measure disparities in LLM candidate selection rates.

Counterfactual name substitution using distinct male and female names in candidate profiles, while holding race and disability information constant, to observe intersectional bias in selection preferences.

Counterfactual name substitution using names associated with White, Black, Hispanic, and Asian demographic groups in candidate profiles, while holding gender and disability information constant, to measure intersectional bias in selection preferences.
